brief.subject: Interactive 3D Christmas globe
brief.sequence: Continuous falling snow, brief decaying oscillation with snow agitation, return to rest

assumptions.snow: Replace static snow sprites with continuously falling points.
assumptions.background: Dark pine to complement the existing red and gold model.

technology: Three.js with a single renderer loop and a procedural damped shake.

revision.brief: Remove button controls, move model to the bottom of the page, add snow effect for the whole page
revision.layout: Globe anchored to the bottom of the viewport
revision.permission: First globe activation requests permission where required

rotationRevision.brief: User should be able to rotate globe on desktop and mobile. Only horizontaly.

lightingRevision.brief: add more realistic light to the globe to improve 3D effect of the glass
lightingRevision.glass: Angle-dependent rim reflections with warm key and cool fill highlights

presentsRevision.brief: When globe shakes, move randomly presents inside.
presentsRevision.geometry: 10 matching box and ribbon vertex ranges in the existing GLB
presentsRevision.motion: Randomized hops and tilts during each shake, followed by a return to the authored resting positions
